architecture_decisions.decision: Compact widths use a dedicated Chat/Build/Project shell while non-compact widths retain the existing desktop shell.
Work Specification and engineering details use progressive disclosure on mobile; authoritative state remains unchanged and server-owned.
Mobile screens use a single primary vertical scrolling context with keyboard-safe composer and practical touch targets.

work_items.summary: Implement mobile shell navigation, compact project/mode header, Chat composition, and Project destination.
Implement dedicated mobile Work Specification review and plain-language amendment recovery without nested scrolling.
Implement guided authoritative Build lifecycle plus progressive detail access while preserving desktop Observability.
Add deterministic phone-width acceptance and regression coverage.

validations.name: client-release-gates
validations.summary: Run client typecheck, state/unit checks, web export, existing browser/Skia acceptance and exact-head repository CI.

validations.name: mobile-behavior
validations.summary: Verify Chat/Build/Project navigation, specification review, amendment recovery, guided stage truth, project switching, single-scroll behavior, composer reachability and touch/accessibility behavior at representative phone widths.

risks.risk: Compact composition could accidentally duplicate or infer protected state.
risks.mitigation: Render only existing Work Specification/Engineering Run/API facts and preserve current protected mutations.

risks.risk: Responsive changes could regress desktop or create hidden/overlapping controls on narrow phones.
risks.mitigation: Keep compact branching isolated and add desktop regression plus representative phone-width acceptance.

risks.risk: Progressive disclosure could hide necessary engineering evidence.
risks.mitigation: Keep evidence reachable from Build details without making it a primary destination.
